gaps: The report has no washing-machine-specific component dataset; this is the generic GLO mix from television, desktop-computer and laptop printed wiring boards, so the BAFU dataset's composition may differ.

The dataset is a pure two-line assembly: no energy, no transport, no infrastructure and no direct emissions of its own; everything sits in the passive and active sub-datasets (Tab. 11.5 and Tab. 11.6).
